description: This PHP class implements a session connection interface for AWS DynamoDB, handling read, write, delete, and cleanup of session data in DynamoDB.

classes.name: StandardSessionConnection
classes.description: Implements session storage operations (read, write, delete, deleteExpired) for DynamoDB.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the connection with a DynamoDbClient and configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data by ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes or updates session data in DynamoDB.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes session data by ID from DynamoDB.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Deletes expired session items from DynamoDB.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Formats the session ID into a DynamoDB key array.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Triggers a PHP warning with the provided error message.
